description: This file defines an interface for a test durable grain in an Orleans project, including methods for retrieving activation ID, setting values, and getting values.

methods.name: GetActivationId
methods.description: Returns a task that resolves to the activation ID GUID of the grain.

methods.name: SetValues
methods.description: Sets the name and counter values of the grain.

methods.name: GetValues
methods.description: Retrieves the stored name and counter values as a tuple.
